en.title: Global Macro — Growth data turns the long end back into the dominant global shock
en.deck: A strong U.S. activity surprise and weak Treasury auction pushed the 10-year above 5.1%, transmitted into Japanese bonds and restored sovereign duration as the main cross-asset tightening channel while oil risk rebounded.
en.regime: Resilient nominal growth is colliding with a renewed global sovereign-duration shock and incomplete energy normalization.
en.key_risk: Long sovereign yields remain above recent peaks while crude or refined-product inflation reaccelerates.

pt-BR.title: Global Macro — Surpresa de crescimento devolve ao juro longo o papel de principal choque global
pt-BR.deck: Surpresa forte de atividade nos EUA e leilão fraco de Treasuries levaram o juro de 10 anos acima de 5,1%, transmitiram pressão aos títulos japoneses e recolocaram a duração soberana como principal canal de aperto entre ativos, enquanto o risco do petróleo voltou a subir.
pt-BR.regime: Crescimento nominal resiliente colide com novo choque global de juros soberanos longos e normalização energética incompleta.
pt-BR.key_risk: Juros soberanos longos permanecem acima dos picos recentes enquanto a inflação de petróleo ou derivados reacelera.

novelty_gate.dominant_delta: The dominant mechanism changed from falling oil/conditional geopolitical relief to a U.S.-led sovereign-duration selloff after a 58.4 flash composite PMI, weak five-year auction reception and a 15 bp one-day rise in the official 10-year Treasury yield to 5.11%, with immediate spillover to a 3.055% Japan 10-year yield.
novelty_gate.repetition_control: Oil relief is demoted to background; energy appears only where the 23 September rebound and record diesel crack stress materially interact with the new rates shock.
